Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × Scotland Office × Scottish Devolution × Holyrood × Scots Law Scotland Office — Scottish Devolution & Governance AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance framework for the Scotland Office — covering Scottish devolution settlement, Holyrood governance, NHS Scotland, Scots law system, and energy transition across 12 mission-critical entry points. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 12 Entry Points Devolution 1. Scottish Parliament Holyrood (129 MSPs), Scottish Parliament elections, Scotland Act 1998/2016, legislative competence. Presiding Officer, committee system, and parliamentary bureau. Government 2. Scottish Government First Minister and Cabinet, Programme for Government, Scottish Government directorates. Ministerial code, Scottish civil service, and policy delivery across 70+ devolved areas. Justice 3. Justice System Criminal and civil justice (fully devolved), Lord Advocate, Crown Office, High Court. Police Scotland, Scottish Prison Service, and Community Justice Scotland. Fiscal 4. Fiscal Framework Scottish block grant (£30bn+), Scottish Rate of Income Tax (SRIT), Land & Buildings Transaction Tax. Fiscal framework agreement, borrowing powers, and revenue assignment. Health 5. NHS Scotland NHS Scotland (14 health boards), integration of health & social care, Scottish Ambulance Service. Public Health Scotland, Golden Jubilee Hospital, and elective care. Education 6. Education & Skills Curriculum for Excellence, Scottish Qualifications Authority, Education Scotland. Gaelic medium education, widening access, and student funding (SAAS). Law 7. Scots Law & Legal System Distinct Scots law system, Court of Session, Sheriff Courts, Scottish Law Commission. Legal aid, legal profession regulation, and Scots private law. Economy 8. Economic Development Scottish National Investment Bank, Scottish Enterprise, Highlands & Islands Enterprise. Enterprise areas, City Deals, and Scottish trade. Energy 9. Energy & Climate Net zero 2045 target, ScotWind, onshore wind, North Sea transition. Scottish National Planning Framework, energy consents, and CCUS. Transport 10. Transport Scotland Transport Scotland operations, rail franchise, trunk road network. Ferry services (CalMac), air routes, and active travel infrastructure. Housing 11. Housing & Communities Housing to 2040 strategy, affordable housing supply programme, rent controls. Local government (32 councils), community empowerment, and planning reform. Accountability 12. Parliamentary Accountability Scottish Affairs Committee, Scotland Questions, Westminster legislation for Scotland. Secretary of State for Scotland, reserved matters, and Sewel Convention. 8 Transformation Priorities Priority 1 Holyrood Digital Parliament Bill processing time 8wk→real-time, committee evidence synthesis -80%. AI-assisted parliamentary operations, legislative competence checking under Scotland Act, and bilingual Gaelic support. Target: fully digital Scottish Parliament legislative pipeline. Priority 2 NHS Scotland AI Command Patient pathway optimisation -55% waiting times, resource allocation +65% efficiency. AI across 14 health boards, integration with health & social care partnerships, and emergency care demand forecasting. Target: NHS Scotland 12-week treatment guarantee for all. Priority 3 Scots Law AI Research Legal research time -70%, Scots law precedent matching +90%. AI-powered Court of Session case analysis, Sheriff Court scheduling, and legal aid eligibility assessment. Target: access to justice improved for 100% of Scottish residents.
